proposed_capability: Document isolated source recovery for the existing oldest lab restock launcher when the development checkout contains local work.
player_save_control_impact: Use the existing host controller and admission checks. Preserve development commits, edits, and private lab evidence.
expected_outcome: A Windows agent can reach the existing launch controller from a clean detached worktree without a decision about the development branch.
negative_tests: Dirty divergent development checkout retains its branch, commits, index and files.
A Git checkout or offline process cannot satisfy live game proof.
rollback_path: Revert the handoff changes and remove only the owned clean worktree when it is no longer needed.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build Windows adapter and gameplay certification under #171.
